name: Undying Engine
rule: 6% lifesteal always. Fires itself below 35% HP when ready.
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: square full-bleed Transcendence illustration for a serious fantasy action game's augment upgrade card.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved Magic Missile painting; Image 2 is the approved Spirit Slash painting. Both are supporting STYLE references. Derive a sibling card illustration by preserving their COARSE MATTE GOUACHE character, then changing the ability motif to the one below.
Scene/backdrop: warm ochre-grey stone arches, worn quiet steps and a restrained lighter neutral atmosphere. Soft ambient daylight, serious contemplative mood.
Subject: Undying Engine. A simplified ivory protective heart-seal, suspended above a warm stone plinth, cracks at its lower edge and kindles again from within. A warm rust-gold current flows inward from three fading small marks into the heart while a broad ivory arc wraps around it protectively. Show returning life and self-starting protection with flat paint; no literal engine.
Gameplay change informing the motif: 6% lifesteal always. Fires itself below 35% HP when ready.
Style/medium: VERY COARSE matte gouache, broad visible brush strokes, flat shapes using only a few tone values, simplified silhouettes and edges, handmade paper paint texture. Make the upgrade readable at a small card size. The main ability motif occupies most of the center and middle foreground.
Color palette: warm stone and ivory; restrained blue-grey, burgundy, sage and muted ochre accents. Keep the tonal family and sober atmosphere of the references while allowing a lighter neutral background.
Constraints: ONE square illustration, no split panels, no borders or frame, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no watermark. The count and mechanical change must be visible in the ability motif rather than added frame glow. No evil background enemies. No realistic machinery. Avoid HD/photorealism, glossy metal, luminous neon, lens effects, bokeh, gradients, intricate realistic detail, sharp microtexture and finely rendered faces. Preserve broad matte painted shapes and visible coarse brushwork.
